note: Figma native annotations hidden from section 'Circle Display Updated' (609:2719) in file ytRlQ7ouw1KocGcTb2HmfX on 2026-10-07. Each node also keeps its copy in shared plugin data (namespace 'mytoki', key 'hiddenAnnotations'). To restore: node.annotations = JSON.parse(node.getSharedPluginData('mytoki','hiddenAnnotations')). Some notes predate the design system and still say 'lime' for the reminder, the Now row and similar.

annotations.name: Rewards · 01 · Shop
annotations.label: Example before any request: 26 available stars. Ice cream costs 20, a book 15, and movie night 40. The old mixed pending example was replaced so availability math stays consistent. Cards with long names wrap rather than truncate; scroll the shelf when more rewards are added. Existing page navigation remains.

annotations.name: Reward · Ice cream trip
annotations.label: The entire card is a selection target; the 44 px arrow makes the next step clear. Selection opens a confirmation, and never spends stars immediately.

annotations.name: Reward · New book
annotations.label: Available for 15 stars. Use the same review-and-ask pattern, showing 26 − 15 = 11 left to spend. The linked demo follows the ice cream path.

annotations.name: Reward · Movie night
annotations.label: Price stays visible. Calculate stars to go from AVAILABLE stars after pending requests, not the total balance. Avoid a shaming lock or a false buy action.

annotations.name: Rewards · 05 · Approved!
annotations.label: Triggered only by a real grown-up approval event. Keep the existing concentric dot burst and solid Biscuit artwork. A short celebration resolves to a readable reward receipt; respect reduced motion. This frame is intentionally not reached by a child-controlled approval button.

annotations.name: Wheel · six clear choices
annotations.label: Six distinct solid-color slices replace the blended rainbow. All labels stay upright. Wheel and central Spin control are concentric with the 466px display at 233,233. Biscuit vectors are preserved exactly.

annotations.name: Spin · primary action
annotations.label: Tap the large center once to spin. In implementation, provide immediate press feedback, ignore repeat taps while spinning, keep the pointer fixed, and ease to exactly one choice before showing the result. Reduced motion: a short crossfade to the same result. No currency, prize, or task completion is awarded.

annotations.name: Biscuit games · opens game picker
annotations.label: Open the Biscuit game picker. This is separate from the wheel's off-screen activity suggestion.

annotations.name: Chores · available first
annotations.label: Keep available chores first; order chores with windows by end time, then Anytime. Completed chores remain readable below. For longer lists, scroll the list while the heading and carousel navigation remain fixed. No star rewards are added.

annotations.name: Chore · Clean your room
annotations.label: Example window: 15:00–18:00, for layout demonstration only. Display the actual chore window_start and window_end. This is an availability window, not a countdown or estimated duration.

annotations.name: Complete · tap circle
annotations.label: 44 × 44 completion target. Tap after finishing; fill the circle, show a check, update progress, and allow undo.

annotations.name: Chore · Feed the fish
annotations.label: When a chore has no time window, show “Anytime”.

annotations.name: Complete · tap circle
annotations.label: 44 × 44 completion target. Tap after finishing; fill the circle, show a check, update progress, and allow undo.

annotations.name: Completed · tap to undo
annotations.label: Tap again to undo an accidental completion.

annotations.name: Biscuit games · opens game picker
annotations.label: Open the Biscuit game picker. This is separate from the wheel's off-screen activity suggestion.

annotations.name: Wheel result · chosen activity
annotations.label: The wheel suggests an off-screen free-time activity. This example lands on Lego. Reveal one large picture, its name, and a short invitation; no Start control is needed. Spin again returns to the wheel. The separate Games control opens Biscuit games and is not an action for the chosen wheel activity.

annotations.name: Free time · Dinner soon
annotations.label: Keep the same title/time and Next anchors as Home. The reminder is one large lime target. Tapping acknowledges the message; the real schedule, not a game action, determines when Dinner starts.

annotations.name: Playtime · Menu
annotations.label: The game picker keeps the original circular Biscuit scene so the five large choices fit around the character. Each active game opens into a full-display play field. All illustrations use the existing artwork and palette.

annotations.name: Category · Head

annotations.name: Playtime · Bath time
annotations.label: Drag directly over the muddy spots. Scrub → Rinse → Dry advances after each step; the numbered strip shows progress. Keep the scene interactive and do not make the child hunt for a separate tool button.

annotations.name: Playtime · Carrot catch
annotations.label: Drag anywhere left/right to move Biscuit and catch carrots. Full display play field, one instruction, current count only; keep best-score comparisons off this active screen.

annotations.name: Playtime · Bubble pop
annotations.label: Tap any bubble. Use forgiving touch regions of at least 44px, larger than the drawn bubble when necessary. Keep decorative star bursts distinct from the reward-shop star currency.

annotations.name: Playtime · Peekaboo
annotations.label: Each bush is a large tap target. A wrong guess gives a gentle wiggle; finding Biscuit gives a short reveal, then another round. Back returns to the game picker.

annotations.name: Playtime · See you later

annotations.name: Connection · Can’t reach the internet

annotations.name: Rewards · 02 · Choose and ask
annotations.label: No spend on selection. Ask sends a pending request, reserves 20 stars, and leaves 6 available. Not now returns without changes. Disable repeat submissions while sending. On failure keep the stars unchanged and show Try again. This is a static design prototype, not a live purchase.

annotations.name: Rewards · 03 · Waiting
annotations.label: Request received, not yet approved. Keep this calm; the full Biscuit celebration happens only after approval. Do not auto-advance or let the child approve it. If denied, release reserved stars and say “Not this time”; if the request fails, show retry without holding stars.

annotations.name: Rewards · 04 · Shop with a request
annotations.label: Example after asking for ice cream: total stars remain 26 while approval is pending; 20 are saved for this request, leaving 6 available. Book needs 9 more and movie night needs 34. Bedtime streak remains separate from shopping.

annotations.name: Reward · Ice cream trip
annotations.label: A request is already pending. Show its status instead of allowing another purchase. 20 stars are reserved; 6 remain available.
